name: Adult orthodontics (category guide)
summary: Braces / clear aligners in your 20s–40s — orthodontist vs GP dentist honesty, Invisalign price bands, and why retainers are not optional.
body: Adult braces are normal in Singapore; forum quotes commonly land metal cases in the mid-thousands SGD and comprehensive clear-aligner plans higher, before extractions and retainers. Complex bites, jaw discrepancies, or sleep-apnoea-related orthodontics belong with an orthodontist (extra specialty training), not only a GP dentist selling a brand tray. Ask who monitors mid-course, what happens if you travel for months, and the retainer plan after active treatment — skipping retainers is the classic relapse story. Corporate dental riders often exclude orthodontics or cap it tightly; get the schedule in writing before a scan deposit. Distinct from children’s braces (see the kids orthodontics guide) and from general dental care listings. This is a category guide, not a ranked Invisalign clinic list.
